limitations: Native execution tests use PowerShell7/Linux and isolated synthetic named volumes; no Windows5.1/user original data or original startup has been exercised.
The source preflight and existing helper byte comparison are preserved and separately tested; the end-to-end live lifecycle test stubs source snapshot/financial context for synthetic volumes only.
A PostgreSQL default read-only setting does not prevent WAL/recovery/control-file writes during startup/shutdown; that separate scope remains unapproved.
The approval placeholder is disabled, its configured trusted hash is null, and the entire packet is sealed; it is a review artifact, not a received approval.
Readiness/shutdown loops have 60/30-second observation targets with separately bounded CLI calls; total duration may be longer.
A CLI/startup failure may leave stop/clean-exit state unverified; the tool reports uncertainty and never retries, force-kills, deletes resources or resets PID files.
The original data directory may differ physically from the old backup after an approved startup; no automatic old-guard bypass or backup overwrite is provided.
Current exchange/source freshness, row/advisory locking, original ledger writes, ownership takeover, baseline adoption and order execution are excluded.
